title: 4BR Gulf Front Rosemary Beach Home with Beach Access
h1: Shell Of A View Cottage And Carriage House
meta_description: Relax in this 4BR, 5BA Gulf-front home in Rosemary Beach, FL, with private beach access, access to four community pools, and 6 cruiser bikes. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Gulf Front- Designated Garage Parking For Two Vehicles- 6 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bicycles- Separate Carriage House Included- Access To Four Community Pools & Beach Walkovers- Propane GrillDiscover Your Dream Beach Escape at Shell of a View Cottage & Carriage HouseWelcome to Shell of a View Cottage & Carriage House, a stunning Gulf Front luxury vacation rental steps from the sugar-white sands of Rosemary Beach. Combining timeless coastal charm with modern sophistication, this thoughtfully designed retreat is perfect for families and groups looking to create unforgettable memories.Spend your days basking on the pristine beaches or strolling through the vibrant town, where boutique shops, gourmet dining, and charming cobblestone streets await just a short walk from your door.The spacious cottage and carriage house comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with four bedrooms and five bathrooms. The inviting layout offers plenty of room to relax, connect, and unwind, making it an ideal home base for your coastal escape.Whether you’re longing for peaceful days by the sea or an adventure-filled getaway along the Gulf Coast, Shell of a View Cottage & Carriage House provides the perfect blend of elegance, comfort, and convenience for your Rosemary Beach experience.Main Cottage -First Floor:Primary Suite:King-sized bed with a spa-like en-suite bathroom featuring an oversized tub and separate walk-in shower. (Sleeps 2)Includes a sitting area with a sleeper sofa, creating a family suite or private workspace.Bunk Room:Two built-in twin bunk beds with en-suite bathroom and flat-screen TV, ideal for younger guests or families. (Sleeps 4)Second Floor:Living Area:Vaulted ceilings and breathtaking coastal views. Features a gas-stone fireplace, plush seating, a large flat-screen TV, and a Sonos sound bar. Amazing sunrise and sunsets from the gulf-facing balcony off of the living room.Gourmet Kitchen & Dining:High-end stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and a wine fridge.The dining table seats eight, plus three additional countertop seats for casual dining.The laundry room, located off the kitchen, also functions as a pantry.Cozy Nook:A stair-landing nook with a plush chaise lounge, perfect for reading.Additional Full Bath:Located near the stair landing, includes a walk-in shower.Third Floor:Private Bedroom:Queen bed with an en-suite bathroom, offering extra privacy and a serene retreat. (Sleeps 2)Carriage House -Living & Dining:Cozy living area with a bar seating three.Fully equipped kitchen with full-sized appliances.Cafe table for two, perfect for intimate dining or morning coffee.Bedroom: Open concept on the main level of the carriageKing-sized bed, flat-screen TV, and full bathroom for ultimate comfort. (Sleeps 2)Loft Area:Two twin beds with two trundles—ideal for children or additional guests. (Sleeps 2)TDT-048712
